name: Church of the Sacred Heart

rules.note: Bilingual (English & Mandarin) on the 2nd and 4th Sunday
Rosary with Mary, every 13th of the month
Devotion to the Sacred Heart; livestreamed on YouTube & Facebook

notes: No weekday Mass on public holidays; public holiday Mass is at 8.00am in the Chapel.
The 8.00am Sunday Mass is bilingual (English & Mandarin) on 11 and 25 October 2026.
Mass intentions for All Souls' Day (2 November) must be submitted by Sunday, 25 October 2026.

info.adoration: Holy Hour: 1st Thursday of each month, after the 7.00pm Mass, in the Main Church.
info.confession: 30 minutes before weekend Masses, or make an appointment directly with the priests.
devotions: Devotion to the Sacred Heart: Fridays 7.45pm in Church and livestreamed on YouTube & Facebook
Rosary with Mary: every 13th of the month at 7.30pm at Mary's Shrine
info.office_hours: Parish Secretariat (Parish Building, Level 3): Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm; closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Church opening hours: 7.30am to 6.30pm (closed on public holidays).
Parking: Level 1 enter by Tank Road; Levels 4 & 5 enter by Jalan Rumbia (from Oxley Rise, behind the Church).
Columbarium visits: 7.30am to 6.30pm (closed on public holidays).
Infant Baptism: 1st Sunday of Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov at 2pm.

events.title: Rosary with Mary
events.text: At Mary's Shrine outside the church, marking the anniversary of the last apparition of Our Lady of Fatima. All are welcome to pray the Rosary together.

events.title: Journey of Discipleship Retreat #2
events.text: Stay-in retreat 16-18 Oct 2026 at the Catholic Spirituality Centre, conducted by Msgr Peter Zhang and the CSC Retreat Team. Fee $280; register at https://bit.ly/cscjdr2.

events.title: Treasure #18 Retreat for Young Working Adults (21-35)
events.text: Stay-in Catholic Encounter Retreat, 6-9 Nov 2026 at St. Francis Xavier Retreat Centre. Fee $163.50; register at tinyurl.com/oyp-treasure18 or email treasure.oyp@catholic.org.sg.

events.title: Pieta Memorial Mass 2026
events.text: At the Church of St Alphonsus (Novena Church), for families who have lost a child. Register by 30 October at https://tinyurl.com/MM2026Pieta.

events.title: OYP Outreach for Secondary 4 & 5 Students
events.text: Morning of prayer and fellowship at Catholic Centre, 55 Waterloo Street, #08-01, 10am-1pm (registration 9.45am). Free; register at tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov.
